name: Lao Trade Portal · Search Commodity (the tariff)
why_not_automatic: manual by decision, CONVENTIONS rule 14: tariff schedules and de minimis thresholds are not legislation, differ in shape in every economy, and answer four indicators — a researcher reads the figure and records it with the page and the date; **and every HTML page on this host answers 403 to an automated client** while robots.txt returns 200 — a WAF refusal, not a robots ban. Its PDFs under /upload/files/ do serve 200
what_to_look_for: MFN and preferential rates on the 10-digit AHTN nomenclature (Tariff Nomenclature 2022). The Trade Portal, not the customs site, is the National Trade Repository that publishes rates; changes are made under Article 178 (Amended) of the Customs Law

name: Law on Customs (Amended) No. 81/NA · Article 94, the de minimis
why_not_automatic: manual by decision, CONVENTIONS rule 14: tariff schedules and de minimis thresholds are not legislation, differ in shape in every economy, and answer four indicators — a researcher reads the figure and records it with the page and the date
what_to_look_for: **1,500,000 LAK, goods value, duties only** — Article 94 (Amended) of the 2020 Customs Law, read in the official English text. It does **not** exempt VAT (10%, in the VAT Law) or excise. There is **no express-consignment de minimis**: Article 52 subjects online and postal goods to control with no threshold and delegates the rules to a Ministry of Finance regulation **we have not located — that is the real gap**. Quote the kip figure, never a USD conversion: the kip has depreciated far since 2020
breadth_basis: measured: read from the law's own text
